en: The postcard features a colored illustration of a well-manicured park with a central fountain, surrounded by tall trees and elegant white buildings with classic architectural facades. The bottom of the image contains the printed text 'Bad Pyrmont.' The reverse side has a handwritten address and message in cursive German, a green 'Deutsches Reich' postage stamp, postmarks (one reading 'Charlottenburg'), and a blue stamp from 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
